title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Islamabad – Master Plan, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Islamabad with the current master plan, sectors, plot sizes, prices, location, development, payment guidance and buyer checks.
h1: Faisal Town Phase 2 Islamabad – Master Plan, Sectors & Plots
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 (FT-II) is a large residential and commercial project near the Islamabad-Rawalpindi region, planned around multiple residential sectors, commercial districts, green areas and major road connections.

This guide brings together the current master plan, Phase 2 sectors, plot sizes, prices, payment guidance, development checks and buyer verification. Faisal Town Phase 2 should not be confused with the older Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 development.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 at a glance

Faisal Town Phase 2, also referred to as Faisal Town-II or FT-II, is the newer Faisal Town development and is separate from Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18.

The project is planned on a much larger scale than Phase 1, with residential sectors, commercial districts, green areas, major road corridors and dedicated areas such as the Overseas Enclave.

For a buyer, the most important decision is not simply “Phase 2 or not.”

You should identify:

- the exact sector or enclave
- plot size
- map position
- current development
- payment status
- outstanding dues
- total payable amount
- transfer or booking status
- exact physical location

Inventory and pricing can change, so current verification is more useful than relying on an old rate sheet or property advertisement.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan

The current Faisal Town Phase-II master-plan PDF available through Faisal Town is dated 10 April 2025.

The plan shows a large sector-based layout together with major roads, future-extension areas, green corridors, water features and other planned uses.

Important labels visible on the published plan include:

- M-2 Motorway
- motorway direction toward Islamabad
- Rawalpindi Ring Road interchange
- Chakri Road interchange
- Main Chakri Road
- Lake District
- golf club
- graveyard
- future-extension areas
- residential sectors
- other planned-use areas

Use the master plan for project-wide orientation, then use the dedicated sector plan for any individual purchase.

A master plan alone is not enough to identify the exact status or location of a plot.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors

Faisal Town Phase 2 has a much broader sector structure than the few sectors currently covered by detailed guides on this website.

Current published project material groups residential sectors across a wide range of alphabetic sectors.

This website currently provides dedicated buyer guides for the Phase 2 areas where we have enough useful information to create a meaningful page, including:

- Sector O / Model Block
- Sector P / The Caladan
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

Additional Phase 2 sectors shown on project master plans should not automatically receive separate pages until there is enough verified information about their layout, inventory, development or payment terms.

This avoids creating thin pages that merely repeat the master plan.

## Sector O / Model Block

Sector O is one of the better-known Faisal Town Phase 2 areas and is commonly associated with the Model Block terminology in market listings.

Buyers searching Sector O usually want:

- plot availability
- map position
- plot sizes
- current development
- possession information
- prices
- O-area references such as O1, O2 or O3

Because the terminology used in listings can vary, always confirm the exact plot number and map position before comparing prices.

## Sector P / The Caladan

Sector P is marketed as The Caladan and currently has one of the clearest published price structures within the Phase 2 cluster.

The sector includes several residential plot sizes, from smaller categories through larger kanal options.

This website keeps Sector P pricing on its dedicated page so a dated full-payment offer is not confused with resale or installment inventory elsewhere in Phase 2.

If Sector P is your preferred area, compare the exact plot, location premium, current discount and final payable amount rather than relying only on the headline rate.

## Sector R, Sector S and Sector T

Sector R, Sector S and Sector T form part of the wider Phase 2 sector structure and should each be assessed according to their exact position on the master plan.

When comparing them, consider:

- road access
- relationship with major commercial areas
- current development
- available plot sizes
- price
- payment status
- distance from major project entrances
- current resale or booking inventory

Do not assume that two sectors have identical prices or development simply because they sit next to one another on the plan.

## Overseas Enclave

Faisal Town Phase 2 also includes a dedicated Overseas Enclave.

Current project-focused material markets the Overseas area toward Pakistanis living abroad and describes residential options ranging from smaller plots to larger 1- and 2-kanal categories. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Overseas buyers should take extra care with:

- remote plot verification
- payment history
- power-of-attorney requirements where relevant
- transfer documentation
- live site verification
- payment-recipient details
- outstanding dues
- exact map position

Numbered Overseas Enclave references may also appear in market listings, so confirm the precise sub-area before buying.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 location

Faisal Town Phase 2 is commonly described in relation to the Thalian Interchange, M-2 Motorway, Chakri Road, Islamabad International Airport and the Rawalpindi Ring Road corridor.

The published master plan itself shows the M-2 and Rawalpindi Ring Road-related connections. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

However, avoid relying on promotional “X minutes from” claims without checking the actual route.

Travel time will depend on:

- exact project entrance
- sector location
- road completion
- traffic
- route used
- current access conditions

For buying decisions, map position and practical site access matter more than promotional travel-time numbers.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Phase 2

Common residential plot categories marketed across Faisal Town Phase 2 include approximately:

- 5.56 marla – 25 × 50
- 8 marla – 30 × 60
- 10.89 marla – 35 × 70
- 14.22 marla – 40 × 80
- 1 kanal
- 2 kanal

Not every size is necessarily available in every sector.

Availability, dimensions and price should therefore be checked on the dedicated sector plan and against the exact property documentation.

Do not assume that a size available in Sector P is automatically available under the same terms in Sector O, R or Overseas Enclave.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 plots for sale

Phase 2 has both primary and resale-market activity.

Listings may include:

- fresh booking inventory
- numbered plots
- partially paid files
- fully paid files
- resale plots
- inventory with outstanding installments
- properties carrying location premiums
- inventory with different development or possession status

That means two listings with the same plot size can represent very different financial positions.

Before comparing asking prices, identify exactly what is being sold.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 prices

There is no single “Faisal Town Phase 2 price.”

Prices vary according to:

- sector
- plot size
- exact street
- road width
- corner position
- main-road or boulevard location
- park-facing or other premium position
- development
- possession status
- paid amount
- outstanding installments
- development charges
- seller urgency
- current market demand

Sector P / The Caladan currently has a clearly defined price schedule on this website and should therefore be checked separately.

For other Phase 2 inventory, use current comparable properties rather than carrying Sector P prices across the entire project.

## Payment plans and total payable cost

Different Phase 2 inventory can have different payment structures.

Depending on the property, you may encounter:

- full-payment offers
- installment plans
- resale files
- fully paid plots
- partially paid inventory
- outstanding development charges

Before booking or purchasing, ask for a written breakdown showing:

- base property price
- amount already paid
- remaining balance
- installment schedule
- development charges
- possession charges
- location premium
- membership or processing charges
- transfer charges
- applicable taxes

Always compare the total payable amount rather than only the advertised price.

## Development status

Development should be assessed sector by sector and, ideally, plot by plot.

A statement that “Phase 2 development is underway” does not mean every location has reached the same stage.

During a site visit or live video verification, check:

- road formation
- road carpeting
- sewerage or drainage
- electricity infrastructure
- plot demarcation
- street marking
- machinery on site
- surrounding construction
- practical access
- possession activity where relevant

Use current physical evidence rather than assuming development status from an old video or marketing image.

## Phase 2 vs Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18

Faisal Town Phase 2 should not be confused with Faisal Town Phase 1 in F-18.

On this website:

Phase 1 uses established block-style pages such as:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block C

Phase 2 uses sector and enclave terminology such as:

- Sector O
- Sector P
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

This distinction matters because maps, prices, development, payment terms and resale inventory are different.

If a listing only says “Faisal Town Block P” or “O Block,” ask the seller which phase and master-plan reference applies.

## Is Faisal Town Phase 2 good for investment?

Faisal Town Phase 2 may be considered by buyers looking for a large newer development with multiple sectors and plot-size options.

However, investment quality depends on the individual property and purchase price.

Before buying for investment, compare:

- sector location
- entry price
- development
- payment status
- outstanding dues
- road position
- future buyer demand
- competing inventory
- intended holding period
- total acquisition cost

Do not rely on guaranteed-return claims.

Future appreciation is never certain, and two plots within the same project can perform differently because of location and purchase price.

## Buying for your own home

An end-user should evaluate Phase 2 differently from a short-term investor.

For residential use, prioritize:

- practical access
- possession timing
- development around the plot
- road condition
- utilities
- proximity to future services
- plot orientation
- suitable plot size
- construction timeline

A slightly more expensive plot in a practical location may be more suitable for a family than a cheaper property requiring a much longer wait.

## How to compare Phase 2 sectors

Do not choose a sector only because an agent says it is “best.”

Create a comparison based on your own priorities.

For each shortlisted sector, compare:

- plot size
- current total price
- payment flexibility
- development
- map position
- access
- possession status
- resale availability
- premium charges
- intended use

For example, Sector P may appeal to a buyer focused on its current published offer, while Sector O may appeal to someone prioritizing Model Block development and identifiable resale inventory.

An overseas buyer may prefer the Overseas Enclave structure.

The best sector therefore depends on the buyer.

## Approval and NOC verification

Regulatory status is important enough that buyers should verify it independently.

Do not rely solely on this website, a dealer page or a social-media post for the current approval or NOC position.

Before paying a booking amount or purchasing a resale property, check the current status directly with the relevant regulatory authority and request the developer's latest applicable documentation.

Also confirm:

- exact project name
- sector or enclave
- plot number
- map position
- booking or transfer status
- outstanding dues
- developer documentation
- payment recipient
- official receipt procedure

If a regulatory record and a dealer's claim conflict, resolve that issue before making payment.

## Buyer checklist before booking

Before committing to a Faisal Town Phase 2 property:

1. Confirm that the property is actually in Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II.
2. Confirm the exact sector or enclave.
3. Match the plot number with the correct sector plan.
4. Verify plot dimensions.
5. Confirm current development.
6. Check payment history.
7. Check outstanding installments and charges.
8. Confirm any corner, main-road or other premium.
9. Verify current booking or transfer instructions.
10. Verify the current regulatory position independently.
11. Visit the location or arrange a trusted live site inspection.
12. Obtain a written total payable amount before transferring funds.

The more precisely the property can be identified on paper and on the ground, the safer and more useful the comparison becomes.

faqsText:
Is Faisal Town Phase 2 the same as Faisal Town F-18? | No. Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 is the older project associated with Block A, Block B and Block C. Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II is a separate newer development with a much larger sector-based master plan.

Where is Faisal Town Phase 2 located? | Phase 2 is commonly described in relation to the M-2 Motorway, Thalian area, Chakri Road, Islamabad International Airport and Rawalpindi Ring Road corridor. Verify practical access for the exact sector you are considering.

What sectors are in Faisal Town Phase 2? | The wider Phase 2 master plan contains many residential sectors. This website currently has detailed guides for Sector O, Sector P, Sector R, Sector S, Sector T and Overseas Enclave where enough buyer information is available.

Is Sector P the same as The Caladan? | Yes. Sector P is currently marketed as The Caladan.

Is Sector O the Model Block? | Sector O is widely associated with the Model Block terminology in current market material, but buyers should verify the exact plot and sector reference.

What plot sizes are available in Faisal Town Phase 2? | Common residential categories include approximately 5.56, 8, 10.89 and 14.22 marla as well as 1 kanal and 2 kanal. Availability varies by sector.

Are Faisal Town Phase 2 plot prices fixed? | No. Prices vary by sector, plot size, exact location, payment status, development, dues and market conditions.

Can I download the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan? | Yes. The current Phase-II master-plan PDF available on this page is dated 10 April 2025.

Are plots available for sale in Faisal Town Phase 2? | Yes, current market inventory exists across several Phase 2 areas, but booking, resale, payment status and availability vary by property.

How should I verify the NOC or approval status? | Check the current regulatory position directly with the relevant authority and compare it with the developer's current documentation before making payment.

Which Faisal Town Phase 2 sector is best? | There is no single best sector for every buyer. Compare your budget, plot size, development, access, payment structure, possession needs and intended use before choosing.

Should I visit Faisal Town Phase 2 before buying? | Yes. A physical site visit or trusted live site inspection is strongly recommended before a substantial payment.
